question: Within the currently authorized zero-Work, zero-finite-quota, zero-cost Phase-1 surfaces observed in this invocation, is there an already-authorized durability/authority witness outside the GitHub/repository authority domain that can discriminate a total same-domain rollback, deletion, or recreation?
prior_residual: CURRENT-REACHABLE-ROLE-SEMANTIC-COPY-WITH-FAIL-CLOSED-GC-BOUNDARY-v1 leaves total same-authority rollback/recreation unresolved when repository-local copies and witnesses are lost together.

bounded_slice.query: external witness monotonic rollback authority transparency
bounded_slice.interpretation: No independent external monotonic/durability witness was observed by this targeted authorized search. This is an observation about the searched surface, not a universal absence claim.

finding.tested_claim: Within the currently observed authorized Phase-1 surfaces in this slice, repository-local branches, tags, commits, checkpoints, journals, CAS tokens, or semantic copies remain inside the same GitHub/repository authority domain. If that whole authority domain and all its witnesses are rolled back, deleted, or recreated together, those same-domain artifacts alone cannot distinguish the prior history from the replacement history.
finding.not_claimed: This does not claim global impossibility, does not claim that every possible external service is absent, and does not authorize adding a paid, quota-limited, Work-based, or otherwise unapproved witness.
finding.scope: targeted read-only O repository search plus repository semantic controls read in this invocation
finding.uncertainty: An independent witness may exist outside the targeted/authorized surfaces; none was established in this bounded slice.

continuation.exact_next_action: On the next invocation, inspect exactly one control-authorized candidate independent witness interface if repository controls introduce one; otherwise formalize the minimum independent monotonic-witness contract required to close the same-authority total-rollback residual while preserving zero Work, zero finite quota, zero cost, CLEAN non-steering, and protected O authority.
